title: Reforging
summary: The Blacksmith's reforges, reforge stones, and the anvil's Recombobulator 3000 and Hot Potato and Fuming Potato Books.

s.x: Every weapon, armour piece, tool and piece of equipment can be made better than it came: a
reforge
in front of its name gives it bonus stats, a
Recombobulator 3000
raises its rarity, and
Potato Books
add flat stats. All of it stays on the item, as on Hypixel, and shows on its tooltip.
The
Blacksmith
works at Rosetta's forge in the Hub village. Talk to him to open
Reforge Item
: put the item in the top slot and press
Reforge
With nothing in the second slot he gives the item a
random reforge
that fits it (never the one it already has), for coins from your purse by the item's rarity:

There are 50 of his reforges, each for one kind of item: swords (Epic, Fair, Fast, Gentle, Heroic, Legendary, Odd, Sharp, Spicy...), bows (Awkward, Deadly, Fine, Grand, Hasty, Neat, Rapid, Rich, Unreal...), armour (Clean, Fierce, Heavy, Light, Mythic, Pure, Smart, Titanic, Wise...), equipment, pickaxes, axes, farming tools and fishing rods. Their stats grow with the item's rarity.
Hypixel's 86
reforge stones
each carry one special reforge (Warped for the Aspect of the End, Ambered for pickaxes, Ancient, Necrotic, Spiritual, Renowned...). Most of them are on the
Bazaar
. Put the stone in the Blacksmith's second slot: the card shows the item with its new reforge and the price, and
Reforge
applies it and uses the stone. A stone only fits the items its reforge is for; the card says so when it doesn't.
Some stone reforges have a special bonus as well as stats ("Ambered Bonus: find Goblins from mining 40% more often"); the tooltip shows it.
The reforge of the item in your main hand and of each armour piece you wear counts; every item with the reforge adds its bonus again.

rows.x: +2% Defense (of what your held item and armour give)
+1 Magic Find and +1% of your Strength, Crit Damage, Crit Chance, Defense and Health from items
-2% damage from the mobs of Crimson Isle and Kuudra
+8% and +10% damage for an arrow that hits a mob's head
A crit deals up to 15% more damage
A kill has a 1% chance to pay 50,000 coins
+0.2 coins for every crop you harvest in the Garden
Double the XP orbs from mining
0.25% chance for the enchanted form of a mined ore or a harvested Garden crop
A sea creature you kill drops +1 Chum

s.x: The other special bonuses (Heat, Cold, the Wisp Pet, Griffin burrows, the Feast, the Spooky Festival, Mining Events and so on) are shown on the tooltip but don't work yet; the stats do.
Any anvil (in the Hub or on your
island
) opens
Combine Items
: the item in the top slot, the upgrade in the second, and
Combine

rows.x: One rarity up (Common to Uncommon... Mythic to Divine, Special to Very Special), once per item. A reforge's stats follow the new rarity.
Weapons, armour, equipment, accessories, tools and wands
on armour. Up to 10 per item.
The same, past the tenth book: up to 15 in all.

s.x: All three are on the Bazaar.

A reforged item's name starts with its reforge ("Fierce Aspect of the End"). Each stat line shows the total, then what the Potato Books add in yellow and what the reforge adds in blue, as on Hypixel. A recombobulated item's rarity line has flickering marks at both ends. An item that can still be reforged says "This item can be reforged!" above its rarity line.
